name: local-ai-studio
description: Use installed Local AI Studio models via the local ai CLI for media and English-to-Korean translation; verify and deliver saved results. Not an installer or general AI development skill.

interface.shortDescription: 설치된 로컬 모델로 이미지·음성·영상·음악·번역 실행 및 결과 확인
interface.longDescription: Discover the installed Local AI Studio CLI on Apple Silicon for local image, speech, video, music and English-to-Korean translation requests. Respect user-selected tools and outputs, run one large generator at a time, and inspect saved results separately from readiness. No models, media, runtimes, credentials, MCP, apps or hooks are bundled.
defaultPrompt: $local-ai-studio로 설치된 로컬 모델을 찾아 요청한 미디어·번역 작업을 실행하고 결과 파일을 확인해주세요.
